# govault_pki_certificate (Ephemeral Resource)

Issue one GoVault PKI certificate without storing it, or its private key, in Terraform state. The private key is generated inside the provider process and never sent to GoVault; only a certificate request is. Every open issues a new certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The private key is generated inside the provider process and never sent to
# GoVault; only a certificate request is. Each run issues a new certificate.
ephemeral "govault_pki_certificate" "api" {
  namespace   = "team-a"
  role        = "web"
  common_name = "api.example.test"
  alt_names   = ["api.example.test"]
  ttl         = "24h"
  key_type    = "ecdsa-p256"
}

# On a self-issue profile role send no names; GoVault builds the subject from
# the authenticated identity.
ephemeral "govault_pki_certificate" "mesh" {
  role = "mesh"
  self = true
}

# WARNING: private_key must only flow into write-only or ephemeral-capable
# destinations (a write-only attribute, a provider block, a local-exec
# environment). Any ordinary attribute would store the key in the Terraform
# state and plan. Requires Terraform 1.11+ and a provider whose resource
# supports write-only attributes; check its documentation.
resource "kubernetes_secret_v1" "api_tls" {
  metadata {
    name      = "api-tls"
    namespace = "default"
  }
  type = "kubernetes.io/tls"

  data_wo = {
    "tls.crt" = ephemeral.govault_pki_certificate.api.certificate
    "tls.key" = ephemeral.govault_pki_certificate.api.private_key
  }
  # Bump to write a newly issued certificate; write-only values are not diffed.
  data_wo_revision = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Name of the PKI role that signs the certificate.

### Optional

- `alt_names` (List of String) DNS subject alternative names.
- `common_name` (String) Subject common name. Required unless self is true.
- `email_sans` (List of String) E-mail subject alternative names.
- `ip_sans` (List of String) IP address subject alternative names.
- `key_type` (String) Key to generate locally: ecdsa-p256 (default), ecdsa-p384, rsa-2048 or rsa-4096.
- `namespace` (String) GoVault namespace of the PKI role; defaults to the namespace of the authenticated session.
- `self` (Boolean) Set for a self-issue profile role: no names are sent and GoVault builds the subject from the authenticated identity. Cannot be combined with common_name or any *_sans/alt_names.
- `ttl` (String) Requested lifetime such as 90m, 24h or 7d; omit for the default of the role.
- `uri_sans` (List of String) URI subject alternative names.

### Read-Only

- `ca_certificate` (String) Issuing intermediate CA certificate, PEM.
- `certificate` (String) Leaf certificate, PEM.
- `chain` (String) Issuing chain up to the root, PEM.
- `expires_in_seconds` (Number) Seconds of validity left when the certificate was issued.
- `id` (String) GoVault certificate record id; use it to revoke the certificate.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key, PKCS#8 PEM, generated locally. Pass it only to write-only or ephemeral-capable destinations.
- `serial` (String) Certificate serial number.
